description: This file defines a class 'DiffArtifactStore' for managing diff artifacts, including creation, retrieval, cleanup, and metadata handling, with associated types and utility functions.

classes.name: DiffArtifactStore
classes.description: A class for storing and managing diff artifacts, including creation, retrieval, cleanup, and metadata management.

methods.name: createArtifact
methods.description: Creates a new diff artifact with specified parameters, saves HTML content, and metadata.

methods.name: getArtifact
methods.description: Retrieves a diff artifact by ID and token, checking for expiration.

methods.name: readHtml
methods.description: Reads the HTML content of a diff artifact.

methods.name: updateFilePath
methods.description: Updates the file path metadata of a diff artifact.

methods.name: updateImagePath
methods.description: Updates the image path metadata of a diff artifact.

methods.name: allocateFilePath
methods.description: Allocates a file path for a preview image with specified format.

methods.name: createStandaloneFileArtifact
methods.description: Creates a standalone file artifact with optional format and TTL.

methods.name: allocateImagePath
methods.description: Allocates an image path for a standalone file artifact.

methods.name: cleanupExpired
methods.description: Performs cleanup of expired or stale artifacts.
